**Limitations**

- The stack covers only the range from the smallest to the largest sigma. Structures outside it pick an end of the range.
- The selected scale is one of the stack values, so it is only as fine as the stack.
- Slower than one Gaussian derivative, since each scale needs its own filtering.

**Artifacts**

- Bands of constant value in the selected scale map, since it holds only the stack values.
- Near the image border, large kernels see mostly the border extension, so the selected scale there can differ.
